summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Arena sub-router with OVERVIEW and THE LEDGER tabs. All core functionality working perfectly with proper mount/unmount behavior, view toggles, and data persistence.
passed_tests: Arena sub-nav shows OVERVIEW and THE LEDGER tabs below header
OVERVIEW tab active by default with KPI grid and funnel pulse
Tab switching with proper mount/unmount between sub-views
THE LEDGER 2-column layout: Products (left) and Transactions (right)
Products table with correct columns: ID, NAME, SALES, REV
Products data shows P1 (Prompt Pack v2) and P2 (Niche Starter Guide)
Transactions SIMPLE view: TX, TIME, PRODUCT, STATUS columns
PAID status displays lime green (#32CD32 / rgb(50, 205, 50))
ABANDONED status displays muted grey (#555555 / rgb(85, 85, 85))
VIEW toggle with SIMPLE and DETAILED buttons, SIMPLE active by default
DETAILED view shows 6 columns: TX, TIME, PRODUCT, AMT, SOURCE, CUSTOMER
Instant re-rendering when switching between SIMPLE and DETAILED views
localStorage homeOS object contains products and transactions arrays
JetBrains Mono font properly applied throughout interface
Full DOM mount/unmount behavior verified between sub-views
